async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Click the 'Created date' button to open the dropdown
    created_date_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Created date")
    await created_date_button.click()
    # Wait for the dropdown to appear
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Click the 'Updated date' option in the dropdown
    updated_date_option = page.get_by_role("menu", name="Created date").get_by_role("menuitem", name="Updated date")
    await updated_date_option.click()
    # Wait for the page to update after sorting
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Filter issues by 'homepage content' in the title using the search group
    search_group = page.get_by_role("group").filter(has=page.get_by_role("button", name="Search"))
    search_textbox = search_group.get_by_role("textbox")
    await search_textbox.fill("homepage content")
    search_button = search_group.get_by_role("button", name="Search")
    await search_button.click()
    # Wait for search results to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Find the first issue link that contains 'homepage content' in its name
    issue_links = page.get_by_role("link").filter(has_text="homepage content")
    first_issue_link = issue_links.first
    # Click on the issue link to open it
    await first_issue_link.click()
    # Wait for the issue page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
